name: Houkago no Iinchou ~Himitsu no Gakuen Seikatsu~
original_name: 放課後の委員長 ～秘密の学園性活～
source:
It started by accident. A thrilling affair with the uptight class president. In the evening when nobody was around, her secret opened in the classroom. The heady sweet aroma of her feminine sweat in the gym closet.

She was your first. You were her first.

Together you explored the endless bounds of passion. It was once... then twice and three times...

Countless copulations. Her body answered each thrust with shuddering pleasure.

你是她的第一次，她亦是你的第一次。

两人携手探索着无边无际的狂热欲海。有了一次……便有第二次、第三次……

数不清的交合缠绵；你的每一次猛烈抽插，都能换来她娇躯战栗不已的绝顶欢愉。
